name: smwmusic-bakumatsu-kourinden-oni-battle-against-the-san-hakase
title: Bakumatsu Kourinden Oni - Battle against the San-Hakase
description:
The San-Hakase (三博士) are 3 powerful beings that you have to defeat before you get to the final boss fight. There are 2 versions of this boss fight music, this one is used for 2 of the 3 San-Hakase (Alva and Tesla), the second version is used for the leader (Raihi).

The versions differ only from their intro and maybe I will port the other version in the future.
